replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My vocational training gave me solid foundations, and I appreciate the clarity math offers. While complex topics can be challenging, I prefer tackling them methodically rather than feeling overwhelmed by uncertainty.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutor recently. It helped clarify concepts quickly and provided step-by-step explanations that were easier to digest than traditional textbooks. The personalized feedback made learning feel more efficient.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves standardizing data, computing the covariance matrix, finding eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and projecting data onto principal components. Don't be anxious; it's just linear algebra applied to dimensionality reduction.
